title: Resolved Inventory Evidence Recorded-Balance Composition
selectedSlice: pure resolved-evidence to FOOD-005Z batch balances to FOOD-006A exact-SKU recorded balance
purpose: Compose an already-resolved FOOD-006E evidence set through the existing pure FOOD-005Z and FOOD-006A projections without performing persistence reads or creating current-QOH authority.
rules: Composition is synchronous and pure.
No persistence read or write occurs.
The supplied resolved-evidence outer structure and retained FOOD-006C manifest are revalidated before composition.
Every resolved evidence batch must correspond exactly to the same-position canonical manifest batch identity.
Every resolved evidence batch SKU must equal the canonical manifest SKU.
Every resolved batch and its supplied movements are projected through FOOD-005Z.
The FOOD-005Z movement identity set must exactly equal the manifest movement identity set for that batch.
All FOOD-005Z batch recorded-balance snapshots are aggregated through FOOD-006A using the exact manifest SKU.
The result retains the canonical manifest, every per-batch FOOD-005Z recorded-balance snapshot, and the FOOD-006A exact-SKU recorded balance.
An empty resolved evidence set validly produces exact-SKU recorded balance zero.
A resolved batch with no movements retains its historical producedPackageCount baseline through FOOD-005Z.
Negative recorded balances remain valid historical evidence.
Input order does not create different canonical balance results.
Returned structures are detached and deeply frozen.
This is recorded supplied-manifest evidence only.
No evidence completeness or database cutoff is established.
No authoritative current quantity-on-hand is established.
No stock enforcement occurs.
No reservation-aware availability or capacity authority is established.
No checkout, payment, fulfillment, sale, accounting or rewards authority is established.
No migration definition changes or migration execution occur.
deferred: Database cutoff or point-in-time snapshot semantics.
